name: Verg
source:
One of the four devils out to devour Konoe. Bad-tempered and impatient, he revels in the power he has over others and holds cats in disdain. He can manipulate lightning.

[Based on [url=http://lamento.wikia.com/wiki/Verg]Lamento Wiki[/url] & [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamento_-BEYOND_THE_VOID-]Wikipedia[/url]]
